messages:
Ava (PM): Morning team — quick draft for beta scouting + feedback loop. Need a fast take before Friday. TL;DR: target 20 partners, 6-week beta, weekly async pulse + biweekly syncs. Sheet with details: https://go.redwood/inbeta (placeholder).
Marco (CS): Looks sensible. Qs: who owns support SLOs, escalation path, and the onboarding playbook?
Ava (PM): Onboarding checklist is in the sheet but we need CS owners for the first 2 weeks. @Marco — can you own initial onboarding?
Marco (CS): Yep I can own the first 2 weeks. I'll need a troubleshooting playbook for common issues. Can eng provide an on-call rota for beta windows?
Ravi (Eng): I can be on-call week 1. Instrumentation note: we'll add a `beta.flag` in responses and a `beta_session_id` header. Also need agreed canonical test prompts.
Elena (Research): I'll draft 3 prompt sets (edge, typical, stress) + a 10-question survey. Goal: measure quality delta vs baseline and capture qualitative notes. Propose NPS at week 4.
Lena (Design): For feedback capture, add a compact "thumbs + one-line" inline on Console and a full form link for deeper feedback. I'll mock a quick prototype by Wed.
Zoe (Growth): Recruitment channels: existing DP list, partner newsletter, and 2 targeted SDR sequences. Suggested cohort mix: 60% startups, 30% mid-market, 10% enterprise.
Ava (PM): Recruitment funnel: outreach -> intake call -> signed MOU -> onboarding -> 6-week program. KPIs to track: 50% intake->signed conversion, 80% weekly engagement, >60% "would recommend" (survey).
Marco (CS): Concern about support load during stress tests. Can we cap concurrent high-throughput sessions per partner? Suggest default cap = 3.
Ravi (Eng): Agree with cap=3 per partner; partners can request an increase. Also propose automated error replay capture (logs + inputs) for root cause.
Elena (Research): Feedback cadence: weekly 10-min async pulse (one-liners) + biweekly 45-min sync. We'll synthesize feedback into a sprintly "health" doc for PMs/Eng.
Ava (PM): Compensation: $3k credits + prioritized roadmap access in exchange for structured feedback. Legal to send a simple MSA + MOU template. @legal-bot
beta-bot: Signup form created — https://forms.redwood/inbeta-signup — collects company, use-case, infra, preferred slot.
Zoe (Growth): I'll run the SDR sequences. Can we agree the initial outreach DM? Draft below.
Zoe (Growth): ```
Hi {{name}} — I lead developer programs at Redwood Inference. We're running a small, paid beta for teams building LLM-powered features. 6 weeks, $3k in credits, prioritized infra + roadmap access. Interested in a 20-min intake call to see fit?
```
Ravi (Eng): One more item: GA rollout criteria. Propose: throughput baseline measured (p95 latency < 500ms, median < 300ms on common prompts), regressions <= 1% on quality metrics vs baseline, and stable error rate < 0.5%.
Lena (Design): I'll add a tiny "give feedback" CTA in Console header for beta users and wire the quick inline flow.
Marco (CS): I'll start the troubleshooting playbook doc and link it in the sheet. Also will compile an escalation matrix.
Ava (PM): Thanks all — quick asks: confirm ownerships in the sheet by EOD Thurs, link intake call slots for next week, and we'll start outreach next Monday. :rocket:
